comparison.objective: Remove corrugated packaging on the dirty side and hand three supply boxes through a pass-through to clean storage.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handoffs through a constrained aperture and contamination-zone separation.
comparison.success_condition: Insert stays on the dirty-side pad, boxes reach the clean shelf one at a time, and cardboard never crosses the partition.
comparison.reason: Tests cross-zone logistics and handoffs, with no impact, intentional component fracture, retained insert, or loose-fragment containment.
